policy: Native source emitted; counted diagnostics have loss:true. Refused targets are counted separately, not as emitted loss.

profiles.subset: Graphviz DOT digraphs with explicit node/edge labels, quoted or bare IDs, comments, attribute lists, and directed node chains; no subgraphs, ports, HTML labels, or undirected graphs.

Mermaid 12.2.0 flowchart: bare/rectangular nodes and directed links with plain text/numeric-escaped labels; erDiagram: entities, fields, four cardinalities and relationship labels. Raw HTML, Markdown, named entities, and literal angle brackets are outside this profile.

Lini 1.1.0 flat block/entity cards with quoted labels, optional tooltip hints, quoted field display types, and directed links between cards or declared fields; undirected links refuse; layout/style declarations are retained with loss reports.
